name: Optimistic_1
short_caption: The robot tilts its head, shifts its hands slightly upward, and then returns to a neutral posture, conveying quiet optimism or listening interest.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral posture and gently tilts its head to its right side while lifting both hands slightly, fingers subtly curling as if in anticipation. It holds this attentive, tilted pose for a few seconds with minor hand micro-movements. Finally, the robot slowly aligns its head back to the center and drops its arms back down into the neutral resting position.
